verdict.rationale: Morph is an API-first service: any OpenAI SDK pointed at its endpoint with one API key can drive it headlessly, a standby tier is documented for batch and background workloads, and Reflex training follows a programmatic create-job/poll flow. A community user also ran it from a CLI tool, and nothing in the pack requires an interactive UI. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs or examples (e.g. pipeline recipes or a GitHub Action), a first-party CLI, and independent hands-on corroboration of running it in CI.
